caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with an upright back and side panels, rendered in a realistic style. The bench is constructed from light-colored wood, with distinct panels of a darker brown wood grain on the backrest, seat, and lower front section. Each dark wood panel is outlined with a thin black line that has a decorative, stepped shape at the corners. The bench has two vertical side supports with a curved notch at the top, and the legs are cut into a simple, slightly ornate shape at the bottom. A wood peg or handle protrudes from the right side, aligned with the height of the seat. Fine lines indicate the planks and construction details, while the bench is shown in three-quarter perspective, revealing both the front and right side. The background is a plain, off-white color.
